🚨 Swiss authorities give latest update on deadly Crans-Montana bar fire

▪️ Swiss prosecutors say everything suggests the fire started from sparkling candles placed on champagne bottles that were moved too close to the ceiling

▪️ Swiss police say 40 people have died, with identification still ongoing under internationally standardized procedures

▪️ 119 people injured, many in critical condition; 113 identified, 6 remain to be identified

▪️ Among the injured are 71 Swiss, 14 French, 11 Italian, 4 Serbian, 1 Bosnian, as well as Belgian, Polish and Portuguese nationals; 14 injured nationalities remain unknown

▪️ Police say identification files have been opened with several countries, including Switzerland, Belgium, France, Italy, Portugal, Türkiye, the Philippines, the Congo, Romania and the Czech Republic

▪️According to Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani, at least 47 people killed and about 112 injured, most of them severely

Just want to share this because seeing AHOF being acknowledged like this by SM Mall of Asia — one of the biggest corporations in the PH — feels huge.  

For a 5-month rookie group, this kind of recognition doesn’t happen by accident. The impact is real, the demand is visible, and the noise is undeniable.

Not saying anything… but it really feels like a preamble.  
Manifesting an AHOF concert in Manila — and why not dream big?  
MOA Arena, 2–3 days. ✨

From organic support to moments like this — look how far we’ve come.  
#AHOF #아홉 #FOHA
